reviews.title: Not getting paid
reviews.text: I earned enough for the $35 payout and apparently you have to watch an ad to spin a “wheel” that gives you a chance to earn shards to withdraw but only 1 or 2 the rest is energy and then there’s a *thanks* square with a smile because they’re getting paid for all the ad watching and they aren’t paying you. It’s been a week or two and I’ve got enough energy for $85 and almost enough for the $135. Of course, I doubt I’ll ever get to withdraw.

reviews.title: This is a scam. You’ll never get paid.
reviews.text: This app isn’t about walking. It’s about endlessly watching ads. They’ll bait and switch to avoid paying you. First you have to watch hundreds of ads to receive enough coins to make a withdrawal. Then they claim you have to log in for a specific number of days to qualify. After you’ve jumped through that hoop, they make you play a rigged roulette game to collect “withdrawal shards”. You will never, ever get enough to get your reward. Don’t waste your time.
